summary.text: John Hewkin is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 120 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A pharmacist, he was born in Salina, Kansas.

paragraphs.text: Hewkin was born in Salina, Kansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the St. Louis College of Pharmacy in 1985.
His career experience includes working as a pharmacist.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee, the Financial Institutions Committee, the Insurance Committee and the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee.
